verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 117.2 (-0.8% in a day) and momentum is 46: prices are steady. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,800 and 86s 5,300. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-30T12:07:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Sergej Milinković-Savić 85 Team of the week after its 73% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 13,000 coins. Now 15,750. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 72.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 4 so far, averaging +2.8% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 3,100 coins. Now 5,300. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 3,100 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 1 so far, averaging +19.8% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,800 (1.33 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,300 (1.29 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,000 (1.27 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,250 (1.48 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 87s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Jacobo Ramón and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Jacobo Ramón 76 Rare -60.3%; Gonzalo 75 Rare -40.3%; Ayden Heaven 75 Rare -40.2%; Maxence Lacroix 82 Rare -40.0%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Nick Woltemade SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 60.4K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
